2607.26509.title: Collaborative Weighting with Pessimistic Critic for Mitigating Overestimation in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
2607.26509.paper_summary: Deep off-policy reinforcement learning algorithms for continuous control typically rely on neural value function approximation to guide policy improvement. However, temporal-difference (TD) learning introduces noisy targets, resulting in non-stationary optimization, while greedy policy updates amplify early-stage estimation errors. The recursive propagation of such errors leads to persistent overestimation bias and degraded training stability in actor-critic methods. Existing approaches attempt to alleviate this issue via prioritized sampling or modified value learning objectives, but often overemphasize high-uncertainty transitions caused by limited data coverage or bootstrapping errors, thereby further amplifying bias.In this paper, we propose Collaborative Weighting Actor-Critic (CWAC), a unified framework that explicitly accounts for predictive uncertainty in value estimation. CWAC employs distributional critic to model return uncertainty and introduces a collaborative weighting mechanism that jointly reweights TD-errors and uncertainty, enabling robust learning from reliable samples while suppressing noisy updates. In addition, we incorporate a stochastic pessimistic value estimation scheme via sampling from the return distribution, which effectively mitigates error propagation during policy improvement. CWAC can be seamlessly integrated into existing off-policy algorithm frameworks such as SAC, TD3, and DDPG with minimal overhead. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed method significantly enhances performance across a diverse range of simulated tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CWAC-348E.
2607.26509.paper_summary_zh: 深度非策略強化學習算法在連續控制中通常依賴神經價值函數近似來指導策略改進。<lb/>然而，時間差學習（TD）引入了噪聲目標，導致非穩定的優化，而貪婪策略更新則放大了早期階段的估計誤差。<lb/>這些誤差的遞歸傳播導致持續的高估偏差和演員-評論家方法中的訓練穩定性下降。<lb/>現有的方法試圖通過優先採樣或修改的價值學習目標來緩解這一問題，但往往過度強調由於有限數據覆蓋或自助錯誤造成的高不確定性轉換，從而進一步放大了偏差。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了協作加權演員-評論家（CWAC），這是一個統一框架，明確考慮了價值估計中的預測不確定性。<lb/>CWAC採用分佈式評論來建模回報不確定性，並引入一種協作加權機制，聯合重新加權TD誤差和不確定性，使得從可靠樣本中進行穩健學習的同時抑制噪聲更新。<lb/>此外，我們通過從回報分佈中採樣引入了一種隨機悲觀價值估計方案，有效減輕了在策略改進過程中的誤差傳播。<lb/>CWAC可以無縫整合到現有的非策略算法框架中，如SAC、TD3和DDPG，並且開銷最小。<lb/>實證結果表明，我們提出的方法在各種模擬任務中顯著提升了性能。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CWAC-348E 上公開獲得。
